go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

expected_findings.defect: `build` and `test` are both appended to `common`, which has spare capacity, so they share one backing array and the second append overwrites the build arguments with `test ./...`.
expected_findings.rationale: `append` reuses the backing array when capacity allows. `common` has capacity 8 and at most two elements, so both appends write the same array slots and `build` ends up equal to `test`.
